name: LX Family
description: A private, self-hosted Family OS for calendars, tasks, shopping and more.
longDescription:
LX Family brings calendars, chores, shopping, meal planning, chat, reminders and family files together on your own server.

Parents get calm planning tools, children get playful missions and rewards, and pet profiles stay focused on care. The guided onboarding creates the first family locally; further public registrations are protected by default.

Your data stays on your own Cosmos server. LX Family keeps its own profile and permission system, so the Cosmos route deliberately does not add a second login wall.
